greed.name: Greed
greed.traitText: pulls void energy from afar, +25% void energy

lust.name: Lust
lust.traitText: half of biting Ybasogs are charmed instead

sloth.name: Sloth
sloth.traitText: Ybasogs near you slow by 30%, 25% slower

humility.name: Humility
humility.traitText: hits hurt 1 less, +2 max energy, 15% slower

patience.name: Patience
patience.traitText: longer safety after hits, instant reshuffle

greed.name: Greed
greed.says: Pulls nearby Ybasogs to the hit.

lust.name: Lust
lust.says: Charms: the Ybasog turns on its kin.

gluttony.name: Gluttony
gluttony.says: Grows with every hit; kills drop more.

sloth.name: Sloth
sloth.says: Puts what it hits to sleep.

charity.name: Charity
charity.says: Splits on hit; a kill heals you.

temperance.name: Temperance
temperance.says: A gust that knocks them back.

greed+pride.name: Midas
greed+pride.says: The slain burst into golden shards.

pride+wrath.name: Supernova
pride+wrath.says: A ring of burning shards on impact.

envy+pride.name: Vanity
envy+pride.says: A mirror-twin strikes from the far wall.

lust+pride.name: Adoration
lust+pride.says: The charmed who die rise as your wisps.

gluttony+pride.name: Gilded Maw
gluttony+pride.says: Swallows any Ybasog below a third of its life.

pride+sloth.name: Throne
pride+sloth.says: Circles you as a guard, then launches.

envy+greed.name: Covet
envy+greed.says: Binds two Ybasogs: they share their wounds.

greed+lust.name: Siren
greed+lust.says: A wide pull, and the pulled are charmed.

greed+sloth.name: Event Horizon
greed+sloth.says: A slow orb that collapses into a black hole.

envy+wrath.name: Spite
envy+wrath.says: Marks a Ybasog; it bursts for triple a moment later.

gluttony+wrath.name: Wildfire
gluttony+wrath.says: Kills erupt in a ring of fire.

envy+lust.name: Obsession
envy+lust.says: Hunts the nearest Ybasog and never lets go.

envy+sloth.name: Rot
envy+sloth.says: Kills release a cloud of rot.

gluttony+lust.name: Indulgence
gluttony+lust.says: A second helping fires right behind it.

lust+sloth.name: Reverie
lust+sloth.says: Lulls every Ybasog nearby to sleep.

gluttony+sloth.name: Glut
gluttony+sloth.says: A slow boulder that pierces and grows.

charity+humility.name: Alms
charity+humility.says: Kills grant a ward that blocks one hit.

humility+patience.name: Glacier
humility+patience.says: A frost shockwave runs the whole row.

humility+kindness.name: Hedgerow
humility+kindness.says: Brambles burst wide and scatter seeds.

chastity+humility.name: Penance
chastity+humility.says: Pierces and washes away nearby globs.

humility+temperance.name: Sandstorm
humility+temperance.says: Leaves a scouring storm of grit.

diligence+humility.name: Bulwark
diligence+humility.says: Raises a stone wall that stops globs and Ybasogs.

charity+patience.name: Mercy
charity+patience.says: Shatters into ice shards; kills heal.

charity+kindness.name: Blossom
charity+kindness.says: The slain bloom into healing petals.

charity+temperance.name: Zephyr
charity+temperance.says: A soft wind slows every Ybasog in the rift.

kindness+patience.name: Evergreen
kindness+patience.says: Frost brambles that slow and wound.

chastity+patience.name: Snowdrop
chastity+patience.says: A frozen lance through the line.

patience+temperance.name: Blizzard
patience+temperance.says: A storm of frost that freezes as it strikes.

diligence+patience.name: Hourglass
diligence+patience.says: Stops a Ybasog, then shatters it for triple.

chastity+kindness.name: Lily
chastity+kindness.says: Three seeds that root as brambles.

kindness+temperance.name: Pollen
kindness+temperance.says: Plants a flower the grazers dive at.

diligence+kindness.name: Hive
diligence+kindness.says: Releases bees that hunt on their own.

chastity+temperance.name: Clarity
chastity+temperance.says: A beam of pure light, instant and endless.

chastity+diligence.name: Oath
chastity+diligence.says: Keeps going: every ricochet makes it stronger.

diligence+temperance.name: Tempest
diligence+temperance.says: Lightning on the wind; flings them back.

charity+pride.name: Largesse
charity+pride.says: Splits into three bolts of natures you know.

patience+pride.name: Diamond
patience+pride.says: A crystal that bursts into blinding shards.

chastity+pride.name: Seraph
chastity+pride.says: A seeking light that passes through.

pride+temperance.name: Comet
pride+temperance.says: Calls a comet down on what it hits.

diligence+pride.name: Zenith
diligence+pride.says: Flies out, then returns to strike again.

greed+humility.name: Lodestone
greed+humility.says: A heavy magnet flung out that swings back to you; calls all void energy home.

greed+patience.name: Stasis
greed+patience.says: A freezing field that holds them.

greed+kindness.name: Harvest
greed+kindness.says: Kills drop triple void energy and heal.

chastity+greed.name: Tithe
chastity+greed.says: Takes a tenth of a Ybasog's life with each hit.

greed+temperance.name: Whirlpool
greed+temperance.says: A spinning vortex that grinds them down.

chastity+wrath.name: Crusade
chastity+wrath.says: A burning lance through the line.

envy+humility.name: Moss
envy+humility.says: A heavy venom stone that raises a wall.

chastity+envy.name: Truth
chastity+envy.says: Washes globs away; finishes the weak.

diligence+envy.name: Rivalry
diligence+envy.says: A jealous twin strikes from the far wall.

charity+lust.name: Embrace
charity+lust.says: Charms, and the damage feeds you.

lust+temperance.name: Allure
lust+temperance.says: A lure the Ybasogs cannot resist.

diligence+lust.name: Fervor
diligence+lust.says: Lightning; each kill quickens your fire.

gluttony+humility.name: Famine
gluttony+humility.says: A hungry shockwave across the row.

charity+gluttony.name: Feast
charity+gluttony.says: Kills drop a feast of void energy and heal.

gluttony+patience.name: Hibernate
gluttony+patience.says: Cold sleep, and it grows as it feeds.

gluttony+kindness.name: Orchard
gluttony+kindness.says: The slain fall as healing fruit.

humility+sloth.name: Mire
humility+sloth.says: A heavy mire that holds them fast.

charity+sloth.name: Respite
charity+sloth.says: Lulls them to sleep; kills heal.

patience+sloth.name: Permafrost
patience+sloth.says: The whole rift freezes for a moment.

chastity+sloth.name: Daydream
chastity+sloth.says: Drifts around you, then puts them to sleep.

sloth+temperance.name: Doldrums
sloth+temperance.says: The wind dies; the rift slows to a crawl.

wrath.text: Slay 3 Ybasogs within half a second, 30 times

envy.text: Slay 200 Ybasogs with bolts that ricocheted twice

kindness.text: Clear 5 waves on 5 energy or less

lust.text: Slay 150 Ybasogs close to your body

swarm.name: The Brood Wakes
swarm.says: Half again as many pods; void energy +25%.

rockfall.name: Rockfall
rockfall.says: Twice the asteroids, and they drop twice the void energy.

ruinwake.name: Ruinwake
ruinwake.says: Ruins drift from the first stage and drop triple.

hunger.name: The Hungry Dark
hunger.says: Feeders spit faster; every kill drops one more.

eclipse.name: Eclipse
eclipse.says: Bolts ricochet once more; Ybasogs have 20% more life.

resonance.name: Resonance
resonance.says: Nature effects last half again as long.

inborn.name: Inborn
inborn.says: begin with your form's nature card

chosen.name: Chosen
chosen.says: begin with a card chosen at the Gate

bell.name: Drowned Bell
bell.says: A ward at the start of each stage.
bell.lore: It still rings under the void, for a city no one remembers.

shard.name: Star-Map Shard
shard.lore: A sliver of a chart of stars that have since gone out.

lens.name: Hollow Lens
lens.lore: Ground from the eye of something that watched too long.

charm.name: Chitin Charm
charm.says: Shells no longer halve your damage.
charm.lore: Carved from a husk; the brood fear their own skins.

ember.name: First Ember
ember.lore: Taken from the first fire, before Wrath had a name.

tide.name: Tide Stone
tide.lore: Two halves that will not touch, however long you hold them.

lamp.name: Pilgrim's Lamp
lamp.lore: Its light falls toward whoever carries it.

crown.name: Broken Crown
crown.lore: Three points remain. The rest were eaten.

tooth.name: Hive Tooth
tooth.lore: It hums when the Mother is near.

salt.name: Vial of Black Salt
salt.lore: Salt of a sea that dried into the void.

scale.name: Mirror Scale
scale.lore: What strikes it sees itself and hesitates.

nail.name: Keel Nail
nail.lore: From a ship that sailed between the stars and struck one.

orrery.name: Brass Orrery
orrery.lore: The planets on it no longer exist. It still keeps their time.

idoleye.name: Idol's Eye
idoleye.says: Relics and logs turn up more often.
idoleye.lore: A green stone that was set in a drowned face. It looks for its kin.

psalm.name: Sealed Psalm
psalm.says: One more rite at each Rift Rest.
psalm.lore: The Choir sang it once. No one has opened it since.

pearl.name: Void Pearl
pearl.says: Keep 15% more void energy after a fall.
pearl.lore: It formed around nothing at all.

l1.title: Flight recorder, the Cassiel
l1.text: Day 212. The stars ahead are going out one by one. Navigation says they are not dying. Something is eating the light.

l2.title: Cargo manifest
l2.text: Hold 3: seed vaults, sealed. Hold 4: void-glass, do not open in darkness. Hold 5: unlisted. Hold 5 is warm.

l3.title: Engineer's note
l3.text: The pods on the hull hatched. We vented the deck. The grazers came back through the vents.

l4.title: Last broadcast
l4.text: To anyone: do not follow the fireflies. They show you the way, then they leave you there.

l5.title: Medical log
l5.text: Crew report the same dream: a choir of three, singing from behind their own faces.

l6.title: Captain, unsent
l6.text: If the hive takes the ship, burn the cargo. If the cargo wakes, burn the ship.

l7.title: Survey drone
l7.text: Rift wall composition: unknown. Rift wall temperature: rising. Rift wall: breathing.

l8.title: Child's drawing
l8.text: A blob of black crayon with two small eyes, holding a light. Written under it: our friend.

l9.title: Glyph band, translated
l9.text: Seven we cast down, seven we raised up. Where two opposites meet, nothing remains, and nothing is holy.

l10.title: Idol inscription
l10.text: He sleeps in the drowned deep and dreams the rift. When he wakes, the void will be awake too.

l11.title: Shrine tablet
l11.text: Bring light to the hollow, and the hollow will take its shape from you.

l12.title: Monolith, the black face
l12.text: There is no writing. Only your reflection, and behind it something that is not reflecting you.

l13.title: Wall of names
l13.text: A thousand names, each scratched out. The last name is unfinished, and the stone is wet.

l14.title: The record of records
l14.text: Those who gather all fourteen will read the Akashic Records, and learn why the void dreamed them.

l15.title: Hymn fragment
l15.text: The Mother does not hunger. She is hunger, given a body so it could be killed.

l16.title: Pillar graffiti
l16.text: We were here. We were many. We were food.

rift3.name: A third rift at the Gate

relics.name: Relic-rich
relics.says: Relics and logs turn up twice as often.

hive.name: Teeming
hive.says: One more new kind each wave; more natured Ybasogs.

calm.name: Still
calm.says: No boon, and no added danger.

pod.name: Pod
pod.says: Drifts down and hatches a grazer.

husk.name: Husk Pod
husk.says: An armoured shell halves damage until it cracks; hatches a horned grazer.

clutch.name: Clutch Pod
clutch.says: Bursts into three mites when it dies or hatches.

bloat.name: Bloat Pod
bloat.says: Swollen with bile: bursts into a ring of globs when killed.

grazer.name: Grazer
grazer.says: Dives at you once it passes the middle.

stalker.name: Stalker
stalker.says: Weaves as it falls and turns once mid-dive.

feeder.name: Feeder
feeder.says: Hovers and spits a glob at you.

spitter.name: Spitter
spitter.says: Three mouths: a spread of three globs.

lobber.name: Lobber
lobber.says: Lobs a sac that bursts into droplets above you.

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.says: Aims a line, then fires a fast glob along it.

watcher.name: Watcher
watcher.says: Marks your column, then burns it with its gaze.

blinker.name: Blinker
blinker.says: Vanishes and reappears, spitting after each blink.

weeper.name: Weeper
weeper.says: Drips tears that fall straight down.

devourer.name: Devourer
devourer.says: Chases and eats your void energy, growing as it feeds.

gorger.name: Gorger
gorger.says: Eats falling matter it touches to heal and grow.

maw.name: Maw
maw.says: Its open mouth swallows bolts from below: strike it from the sides or bank shots off the top.

herald.name: Herald
herald.says: Calls pods out of the dark.

thief.name: Thief Mite
thief.says: Steals void energy on touch and flees.

creeper.name: Creeper
creeper.says: Crawls down a rift wall, spitting across.

lasher.name: Lasher
lasher.says: Clings to a wall and sweeps a tendril across the rift.

weaver.name: Weaver
weaver.says: Spins webs across the rift that catch bolts.

warden.name: Brood Warden
warden.says: A shelled brood-carrier that sows pods and mites.

knight.name: Hive Knight
knight.says: An armoured grazer that charges again and again.

prime.name: Gazer Prime
prime.says: Burns three columns at once; five when hurt.

behemoth.name: Gorging Behemoth
behemoth.says: Eats falling matter and hurls it back at you.

choir.name: The Choir
choir.says: Three hooded heads behind orbiting wards; sings rings of globs and calls deacons.

hollow.name: The Hollow Eye
hollow.says: A vast eye that blinks across the rift and burns your column.

mother.name: The Mother
mother.says: The hive itself: pods, grazers, spreads of globs, hurled matter.

oracle.name: Oracle
oracle.says: Many eyes, one will: its globs seek you.

leech.name: Void Leech
leech.says: Latches on and drains you until shot off.

cantor.name: Cantor
cantor.says: Sings a ring that spreads across the rift.

skitter.name: Skitterer
skitter.says: Runs along the rift floor, spitting up at you.

grasper.name: Grasping Limb
grasper.says: Reaches from a wall at your height, then lunges.

sucker.name: Suckermouth
sucker.says: Clings to a wall and drags you toward its mouth.

thrasher.name: Thrasher
thrasher.says: Hangs from the top and sweeps down at you.

stalkeye.name: Stalk Eye
stalkeye.says: Peers from a wall on a stalk and fires at you.

shambler.name: Shambler
shambler.says: A drowned thing that walks straight at you.

croaker.name: Croaker
croaker.says: Keeps its distance and croaks out rings.

harpooner.name: Harpooner
harpooner.says: Aims a line at you, then throws.

brine.name: Brine Priest
brine.says: Marks where you stand; the brine there slows you.

polyp.name: Polyp
polyp.says: Drifts after you and stings on touch, unharmed.

siphon.name: Siphon Jelly
siphon.says: Drains your void energy while you are near.

lantern.name: Lantern Jelly
lantern.says: Its light bends your bolts toward it.

manowar.name: Man-o-War
manowar.says: Trails stinging tendrils far below it.

gaunt.name: Faceless Gaunt
gaunt.says: Swoops at you in long arcs.

harrier.name: Harrier
harrier.says: Marks your row, then strafes across it.

shrieker.name: Shrieker
shrieker.says: Screams a ring that throws you back.

carrion.name: Carrion Wing
carrion.says: Flies above you and drops bile bombs.

matron.name: Tide Matron
matron.says: Calls the drowned and sings rings of brine.

gauntlord.name: Gaunt Lord
gauntlord.says: A great faceless swooper that calls harriers.

drowned.name: The Drowned King
drowned.says: Dreaming in the deep: tidal walls, limbs from the rift walls, the drowned at his call.

asteroid.name: Asteroid
asteroid.says: Jagged rock; bolts ricochet off it.

iron.name: Iron Asteroid
iron.says: Dense ore: tough, and rich in void energy.

crystal.name: Crystal Asteroid
crystal.says: Shatters into six shards that fly as your bolts.

comet.name: Comet
comet.says: Dangerously fast, with rare materials; a mark at the top warns of it.

cinder.name: Cinder Rock
cinder.says: Bursts in fire when broken, burning Ybasogs and you nearby.

plate.name: Hull Plate
plate.says: A fast, spinning plate of hull.

slab.name: Debris Slab
slab.says: A wide, slow slab that shelters what falls behind it.

hull.name: Hull Section
hull.says: A long piece of a dead ship, dark windows in a row.

panel.name: Solar Panel
panel.says: Fragile; breaks into a spray of scrap.

core.name: Engine Core
core.says: Explodes when broken, hurting only Ybasogs.

cargo.name: Cargo Pod
cargo.says: Sealed cargo, full of void energy.

spar.name: Antenna Spar
spar.says: A long spinning mast with a dish.

ruin.name: Ruin Wall
ruin.says: A carved wall, with two pods sheltering behind it.

arch.name: Broken Arch
arch.says: Two legs and a lintel: bolts slip through the gap.

idol.name: Sunken Idol
idol.says: The carved head of a drowned god, its beard of tentacles.

glyph.name: Glyph Stone
glyph.says: Breaking its glyph grants you a ward.

shrine.name: Shrine
shrine.says: A small lit shrine; breaking it heals you 4.

monolith.name: Monolith
monolith.says: A black slab that drinks light: bolts never ricochet off it.
